proofLevels.local-baseline: Local baseline or fixture that does not represent a product run.
proofLevels.public-claim-only: Public claim or documentation row without direct same-scenario execution.
proofLevels.artifact-import: Adapter result was imported from a prior artifact and was not rerun.
proofLevels.same-run-api-shape: Adapter executes the same scenario stream through a local API-shaped compatibility model with documented gaps.
proofLevels.same-run-native: Adapter executes the same scenario stream through a real local package, SDK, or service configured by the operator.
proofLevels.same-run-cloud-api: Adapter executes the same scenario stream against a hosted API using operator-supplied credentials.
proofLevels.same-run-cli: Adapter executes the same scenario stream through a real CLI runner configured by the operator.
proofLevels.same-run-full: Adapter executes the same scenario stream through the local product pipeline.
proofLevels.vendor-signed: Vendor-reviewed or vendor-signed artifact for the same scenario contract.
proofLevels.real-customer-field: Anonymized customer-field evidence from a real deployment, not a synthetic benchmark.
proofLevels.planned: Adapter is listed for roadmap tracking only.

capabilityGaps: knowledge pipeline focus, not pre-tool action prevention
